photos.source_description: First uploaded image (image-1795388441404.jpg): transparent 4WD robot car chassis with mounted yellow geared motors and black/yellow wheels.

photos.source_description: Second uploaded image (image-1795388451458.jpg): black quartz analog clock movement and associated hands and mount parts in clear bag.
photos.notes: Original image remains a conversation upload; photo binary not committed. Printed model details not visible.

photos.notes: Original image remains a conversation upload; photo binary not committed. Owner confirmed tape is conductive and usable to make paper conductive; composition, adhesive conductivity and width are not established.
